svg.title: Umbra vs Playwright on Northwind Ops
svg.desc: Metric: Cold start to first page loaded, Umbra CLI: 408 / 413, Umbra socket: n/a (CLI only), Playwright Chromium: 153 / 163, Playwright WebKit: 718 / 727; Metric: One-shot read (no daemon), cold, Umbra CLI: 385 / 391, Umbra socket: n/a (CLI only), Playwright Chromium: —, Playwright WebKit: —; Metric: Warm navigate to a local page, Umbra CLI: 27 / 28, Umbra socket: 13 / 14, Playwright Chromium: 6.5 / 7.2, Playwright WebKit: 13 / 17; Metric: Accessibility snapshot (orders table), Umbra CLI: 14 / 14, Umbra socket: 0.9 / 1.3, Playwright Chromium: 3.6 / 4.7, Playwright WebKit: 4.4 / 5.4; Metric: Click + DOM update (role=switch), Umbra CLI: 15 / 16, Umbra socket: 1.5 / 3.4, Playwright Chromium: 16 / 16, Playwright WebKit: 66 / 67; Metric: Fill a field (React-controlled input), Umbra CLI: 15 / 18, Umbra socket: 1.3 / 2.6, Playwright Chromium: 2.1 / 2.6, Playwright WebKit: 3.0 / 3.5; Metric: Viewport screenshot to a file, Umbra CLI: 64 / 66, Umbra socket: 50 / 51, Playwright Chromium: 85 / 97, Playwright WebKit: 57 / 58; Metric: Eval round trip, Umbra CLI: 12 / 14, Umbra socket: 0.2 / 0.2, Playwright Chromium: 0.3 / 0.5, Playwright WebKit: 0.4 / 0.5
